hero.name: Om Jadhav
hero.tagline: I build systems that retrieve, reason, and respond — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and production LLM services.

about.heading: From vectors to production
about.body: I'm a B.E. Information Technology graduate (Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2026) with hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems, and embedding-based semantic search. I care about the gap between a working demo and a production-ready service — evaluation workflows, fallback logic, structured logging, and latency budgets that hold up under real usage.

points: Built and deployed GenAI applications including LLM-powered assistants and automation workflows
Engineered semantic search pipelines with pgvector (PostgreSQL) and all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings, implementing hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector) achieving 92% relevance accuracy
Developed FastAPI-based backend services to expose GenAI capabilities as scalable REST APIs
Implemented prompt iteration, testing, and fallback logic to improve response reliability and accuracy
Added structured logging, error handling, and validation to support production-grade AI workflows
